def match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    """
    Implements a basic regex matching algorithm that supports:
    - literal characters
    - '.' to match any single character
    - '*' to match zero or more of the preceding element
    - '+' to match one or more of the preceding element.
    
    This implementation uses recursion with memoization to optimize
    the exploration of matching possibilities between the pattern and text.
    """

    memo = {}

    def is_match(p: str, t: str) -> bool:
        if (p, t) in memo:
            return memo[(p, t)]

        if not p:  # If pattern is empty
            result = not t  # True if text is also empty
            memo[(p, t)] = result
            return result

        first_match = bool(t) and (p[0] == t[0] or p[0] == '.')

        if len(p) >= 2 and p[1] in ('*', '+'):
            if p[1] == '*':
                result = (is_match(p[2:], t) or
                          (first_match and is_match(p, t[1:])))
                memo[(p, t)] = result
                return result
            elif p[1] == '+':
                result = first_match and (is_match(p[2:], t) or 
                                          is_match(p, t[1:]))
                memo[(p, t)] = result
                return result
        else:
            result = first_match and is_match(p[1:], t[1:])
            memo[(p, t)] = result
            return result

    return is_match(pattern, text)

def match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    """
    Implements a basic regex matching algorithm that supports:
    - literal characters
    - '.' to match any single character
    - '*' to match zero or more of the preceding element
    - '+' to match one or more of the preceding element.

    This implementation uses recursion with memoization to optimize
    the exploration of matching possibilities between the pattern and text.
    """

    memo = {}

    def is_match(p: str, t: str) -> bool:
        if (p, t) in memo:
            return memo[(p, t)]

        # If the pattern is empty, return True if the text is also empty
        if not p:
            result = not t
            memo[(p, t)] = result
            return result

        # Check if the first character matches (considering '.')
        first_match = bool(t) and (p[0] == t[0] or p[0] == '.')

        # Check for special characters '*' and '+'
        if len(p) >= 2 and p[1] in ('*', '+'):
            if p[1] == '*':
                # Either skip the pattern or consume a character from text if first matches
                result = (is_match(p[2:], t) or
                          (first_match and is_match(p, t[1:])))
            elif p[1] == '+':
                # Must match at least once, so consume one character from text if first matches
                result = first_match and (is_match(p[2:], t) or
                                          is_match(p, t[1:]))
        else:
            # Proceed to the next characters in both pattern and text
            result = first_match and is_match(p[1:], t[1:])

        memo[(p, t)] = result
        return result

    return is_match(pattern, text)
